description: Edits a PENDING manual correction proposal (amount, account, cost center, description, note, period). Approved bookings cannot be edited; they are deleted in the app.

account.description: New account, "4321" or "8400/130". Without a sub-account it is resolved automatically when the account has exactly one variant; otherwise pass the full account/sub-account.

amount.description: New amount, in the ledger sign convention: POSITIVE on an expense account books additional expense, POSITIVE on a revenue account books additional revenue. Use a NEGATIVE amount only to REDUCE a booked amount.

contra_account.description: New contra account, same notation and rules as in propose-manual-adjustment.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: update-manual-adjustment
